articles.title: A Glimpse of Childhood in the ’90s: Memories That Shaped Us
articles.excerpt: For millennials, childhood in the ’90s was a world away from today’s screens, apps, and constant notifications.

articles.title: Why Back to Roots is the Perfect Name for Our Program
articles.excerpt: Modern childhood is filled with school, tuitions, gadgets, and structured activities. Back to Roots focuses on restoring simple joys—nature, play, and cultural connection.

articles.title: Slow Down: A Gift for Your Child’s Emotional Well-Being
articles.excerpt: Modern childhood often feels rushed—school, tuitions, activities, homework, and screen time. Children need space to breathe, wander, and simply be. Slowing down gives them time to notice, feel, and connect.
